pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: ath10k: Add support for parsing per STA rx_duration for 10.2.4 Add support for parsing 'peer_rx_duration' as part of 10.2.4 peer_stats. Also register PEER_STATS service for parsing 'rx_duration' (and for any new fields to be added as part of peer_stats). Have checks for backward compatibility with older 10.2.4 firmware incase PEER_STATS service is not enabled (cherry picked from commit "de46c015c9b703bb8abb91856ed45e3639c7e7d2") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I81e04143de77335b7e5bf4cb8137cc7a8dd170d5 Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/323954 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

(cherry picked from commit "774e656e94cdd8db27a8831abb3d35fbb95d2bc6") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I524e03f4b6569f21936438d4baa62659c8943c8f Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/323955 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: ath10k: Rename few function names of firmware stats Prerequisite patch to address checkpatch errors for the next patch in this series, this function names are bit too long, make it short (cherry picked from commit "b4619ea2f72153df42d8ba2894b2af5e621d6df6") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I4ebb0177bddb38f27b34010f3142a8f0cc0e6d81 Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/323957 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: ath10k: Provision to support periodic peer stats update Enable support for periodic peer stats update when peer stats service is enabled. The host to update the peer stats received from the firmware periodically, since firmware will reset this to zero after sometime (due to memory constraints) While enabling periodic peer / vdev stats cleanup the existing list in debugfs if max limit is reached, so that the new stats is updated. Ideally speaking based on 'Michal Kazior's' suggestion we need to completely move to periodic update of all the stats making the 'ping - pong' method obselete. This requires a bit of re-work and some testing as well, also confirmation regarding backward comptability for various firmware and chipsets. Hence allow periodic update only for peer_stats. (cherry picked from commit "d57e7f2e7e042a7cef19702abe42f1e9b55d754c") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: Ibafc505fe388cb338b28122f0f999e11082d364f Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/323958 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: ath10k: Enable periodic peer stats update Register for 500ms as periodic peer stats update period, and parameters like rx_duration that needs to be tracked in host can be achieved by this provision, also periodic stats update is the future of fw_stats and shall be extended for pdev / vdev stats irrespecitive PEER_STATS service is enabled or not (cherry picked from commit "8351c052194b30f852db6225a568e48ee2a4947b") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I929a117d5e05a4a3c91c9d26c3544723e67503fd Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/323959 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: ath10k: Add debugfs support for Per STA total rx duration Add debugfs support for per client total rx duration, track this via the report of Peer stats rx duration reported for every 500ms (cherry picked from commit "856e7c3084399fb7e029628dbe43dcb9bb7d7b5b") (source: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/ath.git) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I1649cca4a08cde7a92a0ad52765b5cdca4648430 Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/324210 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: ath10k: Fix updating peer stats rx duration We are not updating peer stats rx_duration periodically unless the user one polls for fw_stats, this is because we discard the update event since pdev list is empty. Fix this by updating rx duration periodically irrepective of checks for pdev list (irrespective of ping-pong response) BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I825e2fef05ab5ae15b5d784bf392c0789944bed1 Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/324870 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: ath10k: Fix pointless update of peer stats list We periodically receive f/w stats event for updating the rx duration and there is no reason to keep on appending the f/w stats peer list, as this gets completely cleaned up when the user polls for f/w stats {pdev, vdev, peer stats}. Only don't print the warning message in the case PEER_STATS service is enabled BUG=chrome-os-partner:45726 TEST=connected a client and ran ping test Change-Id: I49018cab85b6dd3eda3ba41cba1b214b2822fc06 Signed-off-by: Mohammed Shafi Shajakhan <mohammed@qti.qualcomm.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/324871 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

[autotest] Handle board with -generic in their name get_board split board name on '-' but has an exception only for x86-generic. All board with generic in their board name should be allowed to have '-'. BUG=chromium:581167 TEST=Running test_that against am6-generic machine: test_that localhost:9222 dummy_Pass PASS. test_that 192.168.1.12 dummy_Pass (where machine is a tidus) Unit tests that boards with variant or 2 '-' (ppcle-64-generic) work as well. Before, get-board would report amd64 instead amd64-generic. chromeos-factory: add python-dev/jsonrpclib to factory dependency. Chrome OS test images now come with jsonrpclib, so we can remove the 'third_party/jsonrpclib' in factory repo, and make chromeos-factory depends on python-dev/jsonrpclib. TEST=cros_workon chromeos-factory; emerge chromeos-factory BUG=chromium:403702 Change-Id: Id00eedfca77c33dec49f6f98e349ae6f30890827 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/325701 Commit-Ready: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Tested-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>

factory: remove jsonrpclib inside factory, make_par: don't copy argparse 1. The jsonrpclib is included in test image, so we don't need to keep a copy in third_party directory and copy it to factory.par. But since jsonrpclib is not a standard library, make_par will still copy it from site-packages if it's not building a mini version, just like 'google' and 'yaml' module. 2. builtin argparse in test image is identical to the one in chroot, we don't need to copy it in make_par. CQ-DEPEND=CL:325701 BUG=chromium:403702 TEST=make test, make par, python py/tools/make_par.py --mini Change-Id: Iec2693d9a0503e10b145993b697b7a6a07167657 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/325204 Commit-Ready: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Tested-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>
